annotations.text:
Direction: heritage archive meets modern boutique.
Spectral (serif) + Work Sans; warm paper tones; oxblood accent.
Stamps shown as illustrated "specimen plates" (placeholder for real photography) mounted like museum catalogue cards.
Three directions for a standalone mark, all extending the perforated specimen-plate motif already live on the site. Pick one (or mix elements) and I'll build it into the real favicon + nav lockup.
